prediction_text: Direction: Hillary Clinton wins the 2016 US presidential election. Prediction: the Costa Mesa ISAR conference election panel's consensus, as reported, is Clinton defeats Donald Trump on 8 November 2016 — the panel majority aligns with the polling lead and reads Clinton as the winner; Trump does not take the White House in this panel's verdict.
basis:
Input card tradition: no tradition field present on the card (field absent, noted as-is); system actually used: Western astrology (conference panel consensus, mundane/election astrology).
This case is specified as the conference panel's collective verdict (contrast the single-panelist case in the same batch). Card facts at asking: most polls favour Clinton, and a panel vote aggregates many practitioners' charts toward the conventional favourite. Panel-consensus readings in this tradition historically track the polling favourite unless a strong contrary signature is specified; the card specifies none for this case. The prediction therefore records the panel majority: Clinton. Confidence reflects consensus-reporting, not chart certainty.
